rationale: Classic empirical asset-pricing paper (Moskowitz & Grinblatt 1999, Journal of Finance) using CRSP and COMPUSTAT data from July 1963 to July 1995. Section I ('Data Description and Industry Returns') specifies the data sources, the 20 value-weighted 2-digit SIC industry portfolios, and the sample period. Methodology is fully operationalized: (6,6) individual stock momentum with 30% breakpoints and value weighting (Section III.A), industry momentum IM(L,H) sorting the 20 industries by past L-month returns, long top 3 / short bottom 3, held H months (Sections III.B, IV), Daniel-Titman size/BE/ME characteristic adjustment (footnotes 5 and 17), DGTW 125-portfolio benchmarks, random-industry construction (footnote 18), and Fama-MacBeth cross-sectional regressions (Section V). Six tables of numerical results: Table I (industry summary statistics), Table II (individual vs industry vs random-industry momentum profits, Panels A-C), Table III (IM(L,H) grid for L in {1,6,12}, H in {1,6,12,24,36}, with and without a skipped month), Table IV (IM(1,1) diagnostics), Table V (lead-lag decomposition by size and dollar-volume quintiles), Table VI (Fama-MacBeth regressions, Panels A-D). All variables and portfolio-construction rules are explicitly defined with formulas.
